notes.note: overlay checked; roof over record edge, wall gaps, open chimney, record gap, red dollar match

source_notes: Kept as drawn: the roof's right slope runs on over the record's left edge to its eave at x 127.86; the record's left edge is the house's right wall line, which above the roof comes down to the roof line and below it starts again at y 62.75; the record's bottom edge stops short of the house's bottom-right corner (gap about 1.5 px). The chimney is an open three-sided outline whose legs stop above the roof (the left at y 20.85, the right at 31.45), as on both sheets. The dollar sign is an S of elliptical arcs with short bars above and below, from the red sheet; it sits at x 153.85, 0.85 px right of the record's centre, as drawn. Two rules, as drawn.
